title: PAR-136 ASCII DXF semantic caret/control transport
mode: Generated local ASCII/Binary DXF implementation fast slices
worktreeState: Dirty shared worktree; unrelated changes preserved; this slice is uncommitted
scope: Encode semantic ASCII-DXF literal carets and supported control scalars as documented caret spellings.
Decode recognized caret spellings once on semantic ASCII reads without confusing legacy DBCS trail bytes.
Keep raw carrier paths and Binary DXF unchanged, preserve NUL/CR/LF policy, and preflight encoded XDATA size.

writer: Typed ASCII paths encode literal caret as caret-space, C0 controls other than NUL/CR/LF as caret plus the corresponding ASCII character, and DEL as caret-question-mark.
Strict single-value and chunked paths treat an expanded caret pair as one scalar atom, so chunk boundaries cannot split it.
Compatible text paths transform source ASCII before codepage conversion of non-ASCII runs; the uppercase-symbol shortcut bypasses only values needing no transform.
Typed XDATA round-trip/length verification and the GeoData field-size preflight include caret expansion.
reader: Caret decoding runs only for semantic ASCII DXF values and inside the active converter's ASCII branch.
Unknown caret spellings remain literal; caret-at decodes to its visible spelling and records UnrepresentedEscape rather than introducing NUL.
Raw spelling getters and Binary-DXF read/write remain unchanged.
generatedControls: AC1018 and AC1021, strict and compatible output, group 1 and XDATA 1000
BEL, ESC, tab, unit-separator, DEL, literal/adjacent caret, unknown caret spelling, and NUL refusal
Physical value spelling, following LINE and EOF framing, and DBCS trail byte equal to caret
ASCII/Binary MTEXT group-3 chunk boundary, Binary-DXF byte preservation, and public TEXT/XDATA/ATTRIB/ATTDEF round trips
XDATA value whose ASCII caret expansion exceeds the group byte limit, with existing destination preservation

assessment.planFinding: PAR-136 local implementation slice complete; AutoCAD/consumer qualification and C1-byte behavior remain open
limitations: Local generated readback is not independent AutoCAD or other-CAD acceptance.
No C1-byte semantics are inferred from the ASCII control rule.
NUL remains unsupported; TEXT CR/LF refusal and MTEXT paragraph normalization remain unchanged.
